answer: The strongest single control I know for this is tongue-print pattern commitment, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 704 fakes spends 11264 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. A pearl of doubt is healthy, a trellis of proof is required, and a sparrow of patience is the price of a clean panel. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
